transcript.text: Hello ji
Namaste ji! Welcome. Bataiye, aaj kis baare mein baat karni hai?
Ek baat puchni thi aapse
Kya meri shaadi usi se hogi ya nahi?
Aapki kundli mein love marriage ka pakka yog hai ji. 5th aur 7th house judey hain. Kya abhi wahi baat pareshan kar rahi hai?
Bas itna bata dijiye, haan ya na?
Seedha haan ya na kehna mushkil hai ji. Kundli mein yog strong hain, par thoda waqt aur koshish lagegi.
Aap seedha jawab kyu nahi de rahe??
Main samajh sakti hoon aapka gussa, ji. Kundli mein cheezein thodi gehri hoti hain.
Gehrai apni jagah hai
par itna to pata hi hoga ki hoga ya nhi
Main samajhti hoon aapka darr, ji. Kundli mein Shani dev thoda delay dete hain, par yog poora hai.

Kitna wait krna padega 
 
or kitna delay hai
Aapka sahi waqt abhi chal raha hai ji. 2028 tak yog poora hai. Kya baat aage badh rahi hai?
abhi to kuch khass nhi
sab confuse hai thoda
Yeh confusion Rahu ke asar se hai ji. Sab clear ho jayega, bas thoda dhiraj rakhiye.
Kuch upay hai kya iska
Haan ji, Shani dev ke liye Saturday ko mustard oil lamp jalayein.

Thik hai kar lungi main
 
 
chlo thanks 🙏
Zaroor kariyega ji. Dua karungi sab jaldi theek ho.
Thik hai bye g
Ek baat aur, aapke hone wale partner ka nature bahut sensitive hoga ji. Sochiyega is par.
